name: usb-b-port
description: A USB 2.0 Type-B socket with two upper bevels.
useCase: Identify a USB Type-B connection on a printer, audio device or other equipment.
misuse: Pair this icon with a visible label when identifying a connection.

16.reason: Upper bevels and a near-square mouth distinguish the port. A solid tongue remains clear of the surrounding outline.

24.reason: The near-square opening keeps both upper bevels visible, with ample room around the central tongue.
